title: PHANTOM GRID Axiomatic Semantic Disinfection & Dual-Layer Shielding
full_script: PHANTOM GRID establishes cross-layer dual shielding against composite cyber-physical attacks. When extreme 95.5 dBm electromagnetic radiation is injected with Byzantine malformed logic, the axiomatic engine intercepts the attack vector. Malformed commands undergo formal semantic nullification within an isolated sandbox. Simultaneously, analog front-end active cancellation synthesizes a 180 degree anti-phase wave in 30 picoseconds, suppressing noise floor to minus 120 dBm. Logical incompatibility combined with physical non-intrusion achieves unbreakable vehicle protection.
